GITHUB_LIST_REVIEWS_FOR_A_PULL_REQUEST.description: Lists submitted reviews chronologically for a specific pull request within a GitHub repository.

page.description: The page number for the set of results to retrieve.

repo.description: The name of the repository, without the `.git` extension. This name is not case sensitive.

owner.description: The account owner of the repository (e.g., a GitHub username or organization name). This name is not case sensitive.

per_page.description: The number of review results to display per page. Maximum 100.

pull_number.description: The unique number identifying the pull request within the repository.

GITHUB_LIST_CHECK_RUNS_FOR_A_REF.description: List GitHub check runs for a commit SHA, branch, or tag to assess CI status and conclusions. Results default to the latest runs; the filter can be set to include all runs.

ref.description: The git reference - can be a commit SHA, branch name, or tag name.

page.description: Page number of results to fetch.

repo.description: The name of the repository without .git extension. Case-insensitive.

owner.description: The account owner of the repository (username or organization name). Case-insensitive.

filter.description: Filter by completion timestamp: 'latest' returns the most recent check runs, 'all' returns all check runs.

status.description: Filter by check run status: queued, in_progress, or completed.

per_page.description: Number of results per page, maximum 100.

check_name.description: Filters results to check runs with the specified name.

GITHUB_LIST_REPOSITORY_ISSUES.description: Lists issues (including pull requests) from a GitHub repository. Requires BOTH 'owner' AND 'repo' parameters (e.g., owner='octocat', repo='Hello-World' for github.com/octocat/Hello-World).

page.description: Page number for the set of results. Refer to GitHub's REST API documentation for pagination details.

repo.description: REQUIRED. The name of the repository (without .git extension). For 'octocat/Hello-World', repo is 'Hello-World'. Not case-sensitive. Must be provided together w

sort.description: The field to sort the results by.

type.description: Filter issues by type name. Use '*' for issues with any type, 'none' for issues without a type, or specify a type name.

owner.description: REQUIRED. The GitHub account owner (user or organization) of the repository. For 'octocat/Hello-World', owner is 'octocat'. Not case-sensitive. Must be provided

since.description: Filters issues to include only those updated at or after the specified time. This should be a timestamp in ISO 8601 format (e.g., `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`).

state.description: Filters issues based on their state.

labels.description: A comma-separated list of label names to filter issues by. Example: 'bug,ui,@high'.

creator.description: Filter issues by the username of the user who created the issue.

assignee.description: Filter issues by assignee's username. Use 'none' for issues with no assignee, or '*' for issues assigned to any user.

per_page.description: Number of results per page (max 100). Default is 30, which matches GitHub's API default. Refer to GitHub's REST API documentation for pagination details.

mentioned.description: Filter issues by a user mentioned in the issue's description or comments. Provide the username.

milestone.description: Filter issues by milestone. Provide the milestone `number` as a string, '*' for issues with any milestone, or 'none' for issues without a milestone.
